title: HSBall 솔로 #046 · 헤비머슬 · Romanian Horezu ceramic · 맥주통 쇠공 등에 지기(옆모습) · plump glossy rose-coral lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a quietly weary look, heavy eyelids and a faint tension at the corners of her lips, deep dark brown hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic — a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The painted surface is scuffed and dulled along her hips, calves and forearms, rubbed away in a few worn patches at her elbows, inner thighs and ankles so her skin tone shows through, with flakes of pigment lifting at the edges. Dust and soot streak her temples and jaw, her lipstick is faded and smudged, dark smears run along her ribs, arms and shins, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.

Restraints: A huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a beer keg rides on her back, held by two thick chains of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that loop over her shoulders and run down her back to the ball, the chains pulled taut by its weight. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links.

Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, bent far forward under the weight of the iron ball on her back, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
